name: btn-creative-top
blurb: Colourful bar slides up from bottom on hover, replacing text.
description: A circular button where the text slides up and fades out on hover, while a colourful background bar slides up from the bottom to fill the button. Button becomes rectangular on hover.
use_when: A navigation or action button that should feel dynamic and invite interaction.
avoid_when: Interfaces where text stability is critical.
a11y: Non-semantic button without stable labeling. Limited keyboard accessibility.
